_about: Edition categories (the tabs) grouped into areas. Every story has exactly one category. 'hint' is a regex the collector uses to sort the digest; it never decides what is carded. Each category needs at least 10 working sources in config/sources.json (scripts/check_sources.py checks). Old categories in archived editions map via 'legacy'.
